action.instructions: Choose the best next action to win this physics rooftop duel by knocking the opponent off. Stay on the roof. Use the visible state and previous result.

criteria.GRAB_NEAREST_OBJECT: Go to and pick up the observed nearest object.
criteria.THROW_HELD_OBJECT_AT_OPPONENT: Throw the object currently held at opponent.
criteria.MOVE_TOWARD_SAFETY: Move to roof center away from open edges.
criteria.TAKE_COVER: Move behind the observed ventilation unit.
